items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yes. Iraida González. Iraida González Plana(?). Her mother was raised from the Taino Indians, and her father was one of the most famous diamond-cutters in the world. He

worked with Harry Winston for forty years. I’m very proud of that. And he was my father-in­ law. He couldn’t stand me, because every time he came home from work, he’d see me on the floor listening to records and my wife working... That didn’t go over too well. Heh-heh-heh-heh. But I loved him.
